name: CA Sales Holdings Limited
source: UNITS: every figure in this file is in absolute ZAR. The newest column was read from a statement printed in R thousands and multiplied by 1,000 to match the older columns. CRON 20261122: H1 2026 column from the issuer unaudited summarised consolidated interim results, six months ended 30 June 2026, statement of comprehensive income, unit R thousands. Revenue less cost of sales equals the printed gross profit 973,932. Operating expenses are other operating expenses 677,127 plus net impairment losses on financial assets 1,350 less other operating income 36,785. The printed operating profit 342,341 includes 10,101 of share of profit from equity-accounted investments, which sits above the finance lines, so gross profit less operating expenses gives 332,240 and the 10,101 brings it to the printed figure. Net finance costs are negative because finance income 48,216 exceeds finance costs 25,133 by 23,083, and EBIT plus that 23,083 equals the printed profit before tax. EPS is basic 53.31 cents converted to rand. Ratios for this column are not filled because the half-year balance sheet totals were not read. || CRON 20261120_0440: bare alias and resolved statement unified from the same company's two copies. Period union taken; a blank rendered cell was filled from the alias only where the alias carried the value and its figures run at the same scale (unit guard). The resolved file's own value wins wherever the two disagreed, and every such disagreement is recorded in _alias_sync_20261120_0440.json. | Yahoo Finance
